verdict.rationale: There is a public GitHub repository (circlemind-ai/smooth-sdk) for the Smooth CLI/SDK, so some client-side source is readable. Nothing in the pack states an open license, though, and the core browser-agent service appears to be hosted rather than published or self-hostable, which community requests to make it self-hostable support. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license, source for the core service and agent models, and confirmation that the repo is the full product rather than a thin client.
